error.title: Verification Interrupted
error.description: The link carried no token the provider recognises, or the token's window has closed. A new link is the only way forward.
error.instruction: Request a new link; the old one cannot be revived.

pending.description:
A link was sent to the address on the account. It opens for 24 hours and works once.

If nothing arrives in a few minutes, the spam folder is the next place to look.

The link is a credential: anyone who opens it verifies the address.
pending.title: Check The Inbox

success.title: Email Verified
success.description: The address on the account is verified. Signing in is the last step before the workspace opens.
success.instruction: You can now sign in to the account and start using Code Editor Land.

title: Verify your email
description: A verification link was sent to
instruction: Open the link in the email to verify the account and start using Code Editor Land.

verifying.title: Verifying your email
verifying.description: Checking the email address with the provider.

errorGeneric: The check did not complete: the provider returned no answer for this token. Requesting a new link is the next step.
resendFailed: The resend did not go out: the provider rejected the request. The existing link still works until it expires.

token.expired: This verification link has expired. Request a new one.
